notes.title: New Freelancers and Atlas Reactor Launch!
notes.content:
In celebration of the official launch of Atlas Reactor (the non-VR game) on October 4th, we've updated the Atlas Reactor VR Character Viewer!  In addition to new skins for many existing characters, this update also contains the 5 new characters that have been released since the last update!

The new characters are:

Dr. Finn The 'Eeler - Sturgeon General with a healing gun and energized eels.
Celeste The Rogue - Crafty thief who uses two grappling hooks to steal power-ups and knock out enemies.
Blackburn The Last Soldier - Super soldier with an arsenal of deadly weapons at his command.
Orion The Empyrean - Atom manipulator with a suit specialized to control his power.
Juno The Last Word - A twin cannon-wielding warrior who stands her ground no matter the odds.

Give it a try, and let us know what you think!
